notes.title: HWR: Reforged — Sins of the Floating City. New DLC announcement and release date.
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/fbf8267353a5507ad8ab002b19eec99774c9ea3f.png"]

Hello everyone!

We are happy to finally make an official announcement of Heads Will Roll: Reforged's fourth DLC — Sins of the Floating City. It is scheduled to be released on September 4th 10am PDT and will continue to expand the world and story of HWR. This time with two new massive story branches that will be taking place in Italy during Venice-Genoa wars. As always, the DLC will be accompanied by a major patch containing new items, gameplay mechanics, updated balancing and lots of technical iprovements.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857000/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Sins_of_the_Floating_City"][/dynamiclink]
What awaits you in the DLC:

*No step too far, no measure too desperate
Become the right hand man of the Venetian Doge and plunge headlong into the maelstrom of European politics to help Venice survive the onslaught of an alliance of its many rivals. Enlist the help of allies and defeat your enemies on the battlefield or, through cunning intrigues and sophisticated machinations, set them against each other in order to reap the fruits of their discord. Deception, betrayal, bribery and political assassinations - achieve your goal by any means available and dare to take the most desperate steps for the sake of the greatness of Venice.

*A descent into darkness
Enter the service of an influential Italian noble house, surrounded by enviers and grudge-bearers, and take on the role of a bodyguard who will protect its members from the dangers that lurk everywhere and the traps set by their enemies. Descend into darkness as you make your way through the Venice's underworld that will confront you with powerful secret societies, mysticism, blood feuds and the many vices and sins of human nature.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/badef4b721b81d14272c5722cff02a99c10b10c7.jpg"]

*More than a dozen new characters
From members of various Italian noble houses and famous condottierros to the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire himself.

*Europe-spanning adventure
Visit Italy, France, Holy Roman Empire and the Outremer all within one continuous campaign.

*2 new romantic interests
Each with their own unique story and character.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/de5a0f1403bd320b2b6a6b6698af6a006edf6ad3.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/1243e4136a45c7845858c8fafd31d6732032bab6.jpg"]

As always together with the DLC we will be releasing a big gameplay update that will, among other things, include:

• new mechanics, items, weapons and civic talents;

• improved survival mode;

• a lot of bugfixes and several performance improvements;

notes.title: News About Release Date
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/114851e3bd6f6b3594af4b867fb8b49bceec1a71.png

Hello, dear players!

Here we are again, the release date has been changed again and it already looks like yellow letters from the studio with the Northern Cardinal on the logo.

To the point. The current final date is March 2023. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png

Why such a big delay all at once?
Game can't be ready by October/November and then there will be discounts and sales that will hinder the release. That's why the date is pushed back a bit after all that.

Why the delay ? How complete is the game?
Most of the main story is complete, but then there's finale to make and all the other secondary activities and details that gave this game its charm.

Is another delay possible?
Only as a last resort. The current time should be more than enough to complete the game in its full glory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png

Development is active and by no means stopping or going through a crisis, but creating a project like this almost single-handedly takes time, so I hope for your patience!

Sincerely, 
uglycoal
ːmelonː

notes.title: Windows 7 Patch
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players! Here's a tiny and not so quick fix.

Windows 7 now supports Mondealy again, and should in future. This was a problem with GameMaker (engine of the game) and update to it has fixed some issues.

Full game is still being developed of course, but further delays are possible too.

Enjoy, and try to stay strong and happy.

Sincerely,
uglycoal ːmelonː

notes.title: Day One Release on Linux
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/92e265269464892713dbb822d4ab986f9775c901.png

Greetings, dear players!


If you are using Linux system, you can now try out Mondealy: Day One on them!

The full game will also be released on Linux on release.

This question has not been raised very often or very actively, but no group of players should be forgotten!
It also means that the game will have to work great on Steam Deck!

Linux systems are more complex and more diverse, so chances are that there may be problems specific to them. If you are one of the few but proud users of these systems, I look forward to your feedback! (preferably in discussions, it's easier for me to see everything there)
I will leave this official GameMaker Studio guide related to the libraries, just in case: guide.


P.S. At the same time with the game engine update it lost support for Windows 7. I apologize for this inconvenience. As far as I know, the next engine update will bring back compatibility.

That's all!

Sincerely,
uglycoal ːmelonː

notes.title: Day One's Finishing Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/114851e3bd6f6b3594af4b867fb8b49bceec1a71.png

Greetings, dear players! :melon:

In these troubling times you should not forget to relax and have some fun. I didn't manage to do it much, but I've prepared an update for you!

I called this update "finishing" because, most likely, this is the last big update before release of the full Mondealy game. In this update I've accumulated my new style and a bunch of new content. There isn't much, but quality over quantity, right? Hope you will like it.
(P.S. If you played Next Fest demo-version, this is the same thing. Mostly.)


So, let's get through the newly added stuff:


 Added simplified graphics mode for weaker computers. (I found it useful, too. If you're playing from a laptop, it's advisable to turn this mode on!) 
 Added control prompts to all (or most) menus.
 Now you can take screenshots from Steam! (I didn't know you had to add this yourself)
 Improved gamepad button remapping.
 Cars ride on the surface of the game world! These are little things, of course, but they make the world a little more alive. (Don't run under them)
 Unfortunately, item pickup animations have been removed.
 Added the ability to change player's hairstyle in Corsic's room in the Castle.
 Added the ability to change clothes using closets. (New royal clothing will be available to you by the end of Day One)
 Updated and changed Water District, adding new locations and secondary events.
 Updated many graphical elements of the game.
 Fixed all sorts of bugs, crashes, etc.
 And many other little things you may find in the game yourself!

Don't click on the Twitter link in the main menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/c34cbe26fff5072537ea0674be45690ae3c46e8a.gif

Join game's Discord server to share your ideas, creations and opinions! You are all welcome there.

Well, guess that's it! I have a lot of work ahead to finish the game and remake the intro. And you enjoy and take care.

And don't forget to add Mondealy's full game in Wishlist! It is really important!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1620520/Mondealy/

Sincerely,
uglycoal :melon:

notes.title: Save Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, my dearest players! For a start, I want to thank you all for reviews and general engagement with the game, it has launched unexpectedly well! 
And another thing, we expect you all on game's Discord server!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/6e639e14f90c3b6c62c7e15db5e9b4024a6c3845.png



Last weeks I've been working real hard to get this super useful and wanted feature done - 5 whole save slots! (That's not all, of course, but it's the main thing) (And actually there can be an unlimited amount of them, I'm just lazy to make UI for it)



What will change for you?

 You can now jump from save to save, save them for later, for one reason or another, and just enjoy how more fluent and cooler it is.
 Unfortunately, your current save file, settings and gallery was obliterated. This was a necessary step not to do so in the upcoming full game (better to lose an hour of progress here than many hours playing the full version, right?)
This greatly increases the chances of the save files being compatible with the upcoming full game, so *maybe* you won't even have to replay the intro!


What will change for me?

 It'll be easier for me to make this game :)


And now for a detailed list of changes:

 Added support for additional Latin characters in the game font
 Added setting to turn text hider on and off (if you knew about it at all)
 Added confirmation screen before exiting the game or the menu from the gameplay
 Added automatic sorting of inventory, when it changes (can no longer be empty slots between items)
 Added "Game saved" icon after a save is made (there is also an easter egg there)
 Added little animated radio to Tavern
 Added new music to Tavern
 Added two new tunes for Eliza
 Added music when loading from Corsic Room or Castle Reception
 Added new portrait for Princess Riley
 Changed other portraits of Princess Riley
 Changed Princess Riley game sprites and added new one
 Changed castle meeting scene
 Changed portraits, sprites and scene with the girl from the intro of the game
 Changed street at the Roadhouse
 Changed some of the game window descriptions (there's a bunch of funny stuff in there, you miss it if you only play fullscreen!)
 Fullscreen mode now always fits the game to the height of your screen (pixel perfect graphics fans, I'm sorry, but that's what most people wish)
 Darkening in the dialogues has been removed
 Titles will now stop when you reach the end
 The item you are holding will be removed if it is removed from the inventory while you are holding it
 Fixed an issue where same items were added to different slots in your inventory
 Fixed problem with softlock in gamepad button settings menu if you only used keyboard
 Updated the localization files


That's all folks! See ya' in the future updates! ːmelonː

If any issues come up with this update, I will do my best to fix them asap.
Don't forget to add to your wishlist the full game!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1620520/Mondealy/
